summary: passed=8 failed=0 flaky=0 blocked=0 test_error=0 across 8 artifacts covering both acceptance_matrix criteria (6 browser checks + 2 backend test files, re-run from iteration_5's artifacts). The previously-reported bug (results page header tab bar not wrapping/uniform at 390px) is now FIXED and verified.

checks.criterion: Top links uniform and clearly separated (previously failed on results page)
checks.name: header-nav-uniform-tabs
checks.evidence: Re-ran persisted check: /, /learn, /today, /portfolio, and /?idea=2a3c3928-6c73-4855-b88c-94adb1d60d01&shared=1 (results page) all show a full-width header-nav tab bar with 4 unclipped tabs at 390px, 0px horizontal overflow, matching font/size/colour across pages. /discoveries correctly has no HeaderNav (allowed exception). Desktop 1280 results header also shows the same pill tab bar. Bug from iteration_5 (191px overflow, Practice tab clipped against comparison-header) is resolved.

checks.criterion: Regression: Today strip above the fold on '/'
checks.name: daily-clues-strip-and-today-page
checks.evidence: trending-strip visible above landing-headline at 390x844 and 1280x800; clue card bottom edge within viewport (no scroll needed); 'Open the read' and 'Use as my own clue' interactions work; /today lists clue cards.

checks.criterion: Regression: Learn row above the fold on '/'
checks.name: learn-strip-above-fold
checks.evidence: learn-strip ('LEARN IN 6 MINUTES · FREE') sits directly under trending-strip and above landing-headline, within 390px viewport fold. Lesson chip opens lesson-page; 'All N lessons' opens learn-hub.

checks.criterion: Regression: sign-in sheet offers Google, password and email code
checks.name: signin-sheet-google-and-tabs
checks.evidence: signin-sheet shows Google button, email/password tabs (Sign in/Create account/Email me a code), 'Continue with Google' navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=... (not completed, per spec_deviations). 2 benign 404 console errors (asset probing), no functional impact.

checks.criterion: Regression: password create/sign-in/sign-out, wrong password error
checks.name: password-signup-and-signin-flow
checks.evidence: New account created, portfolio created while signed in, signed out, signed back in with same credentials; wrong password rejected with error text; duplicate registration rejected (409); seeded pw-user@aaspaas.dev/chai-stall-2026 signs in successfully. Console 401/400/409/404 entries are expected negative-path responses (wrong password, duplicate register), not errors.

checks.criterion: Regression: password auth API (register/login/logout, wrong password, seeded account)
checks.name: test_tscheck_password_auth.py
checks.evidence: pytest: 3 tests passed - POST /auth/register new tscheck- email -> 200 signed_in:true, duplicate register -> 409; POST /auth/login wrong password -> 400; POST /auth/login pw-user@aaspaas.dev/chai-stall-2026 -> 200 signed_in:true, GET /auth/me confirms, POST /auth/logout -> signed_in:false.

checks.name: google-callback-invalid-session
checks.evidence: Visiting /learn#session_id=invalid-test-session shows toast matching /Google sign-in didn.t complete/i, #session_id removed from URL, learn-hub renders normally underneath. One expected 400 console entry from the failed exchange call.

checks.name: test_tscheck_google_callback_invalid_session.py
checks.evidence: pytest: 2 tests passed - POST /auth/google {session_id:'tscheck-invalid-test-session'} -> 400 "didn't complete"/"try again", no cookie set; GET /auth/me afterwards -> 200 signed_in:false.
